text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer wasn't feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer.
I think... resting just a teeny bit will fix it!
See you in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, everyone.
Are you all enjoying the party?

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text: "For our side entertainment, everyone will now be playing a special game of tag."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Tag? At a party...?

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple.
All you have to do is escape from the swarm of 'demons'
released into the venue.

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text: Squeak squeak! I'm so hungry-bee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A giant horsefly!?
Eek, just looking at it makes me itch and hurt!

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoever exits the venue within the time limit wins!
And... start!

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text: Vroooooooom!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's here!? We definitely
can't just brute-force through this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides... when it comes to "running away / front-running,"
I absolutely won't back down!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No matter the situation, I will show you that I can lead wire-to-wire!!

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!?
Bzzzzzzzzz-vrooooom?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
That really was a super weird dream~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, that run wasn't half bad, was it?
Maybe I'll test it out in training~.
After having a strange dream where she pulled off a satisfying runaway victory, Mejiro Palmer seemed to be completely back in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text:
Get serious-bun?
Then I'll go call everyone-bun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text:
Great-grandpa! Great-great-grandma!
Great-uncle's family, and everyone, everyoneee!!

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre
text_block_list.text: It's mealtime, zooooom!!

text_block_list.name: Horsefly Ogre Clan
text_block_list.text: Abububuuuurn!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, was it a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, I was way too laid-back about it~.
Lesson learned, lesson learned.

Having had a strange dream, Mejiro Palmer
was left feeling rather out of sorts...
